standard_fermion.description: Standard fermionic pair a_1^± satisfying CAR: {a_1^-, a_1^+} = 1

standard_fermion_anticommutators.description: Canonical anticommutation relations for the standard fermionic pair

bosonic_commutators.description: Canonical commutation relations for bosonic oscillators

kappa.label: kappa
kappa.description: Odd central element of the Bakalov-Sullivan extension. Appears first in the PBW ordering.

K.label: K
K.description: Even central identity element. Identified with the scalar 1 in all current applications; excluded from PBW basis and structure constant computations.

basis.ordering_convention: PBW: κ < [odd: E_eps1_del{k}_{pp/pm/mp/mm} k=1..n] < [even: H_1..H_{n+1}, E_2del{k}_p/m, E_del{i}_del{j}_pp/mm/pm/mp]  (K=1 excluded)

generator_realization.description: Standard form with PBW ordering of oscillators

H_4.note: Terminal Cartan (k = n+1); constant -1/2 is intrinsic to the Frappat formula

E_2del1_p.note: Convention: 1/2 factor from Frappat absorbed into normalization
